user.title: Connect to Velvet
user.description: Enter the address of your Velvet server, for example {example}.

data_description.url: Use the address you open Velvet with in a browser, including the scheme (https) and the port.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn this off only when Velvet uses a self-signed certificate.

auth.title: Sign in to Velvet
auth.description: How do you want to sign in?

menu_options.pair: Approve a code in Velvet (no password needed)

password.title: Sign in with a password
password.description: The password is only used once to get a token; Home Assistant does not store it.

pair_expired.title: Code expired
pair_expired.description: Nobody approved the code within 5 minutes. Submit to get a new code.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Velvet again
reauth_confirm.description: Velvet at {url} no longer accepts the stored sign-in (the user was removed, or the server secret changed). Submit to sign in again.

progress.wait_for_approval:
Open Velvet ({url}) as the user Home Assistant should act as, open **User Settings**, find **Pair a Device** and enter this code:

**{code}**

The code is valid for 5 minutes. This page continues by itself once you approve it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Velvet server at this address.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full address that starts with the scheme (http or https).
error.ssl_error: The server's SSL certificate is not trusted. If Velvet uses a self-signed certificate, turn off "Verify the SSL certificate".
error.no_rooms_permission: This Velvet user may not use Velvet Rooms. An admin can allow it in Velvet (admin page, Users, the "Cast" permission).
error.rooms_disabled: Velvet Rooms is turned off on this server. Turn it on in Velvet's admin page first.

abort.already_configured: This Velvet server is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Velvet server.
abort.no_rooms_permission: This Velvet user may not use Velvet Rooms. An admin can allow it in Velvet (admin page, Users, the "Cast" permission).
abort.rooms_disabled: Velvet Rooms is turned off on this server. Turn it on in Velvet's admin page first.
abort.wrong_server: This address belongs to a different Velvet server.

auth_failed.message: Velvet no longer accepts the stored sign-in. Re-authenticate the Velvet integration.

library_only.message: Velvet Rooms play the Velvet library only; pick something from the Velvet media browser.

nothing_to_play.message: Nothing playable was found for this item.
